chunks: 4662 - Saʿd ibn Saʿd asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about the child: may he be breastfed for more than two years? So he said:
"Two years." I said: "If it exceeds two years, is there anything upon his parents because of that?" He said: "No."

key_terms.الصَّبِيِّ: the child being discussed in the ruling

ai.seo_question: Is there any sin or obligation on parents if breastfeeding continues beyond two years?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning breastfeeding duration, indicating two years as the stated term. It also clarifies that if breastfeeding continues beyond two years, there is no liability or blame upon the parents for that.
